tool_input.command:
S="C:/Users/3D6B~1/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--visual-projects-alpha/3d11476b-7d7e-4310-8ddc-a44cd70e5afa/scratchpad"
cat > "$S/gate12.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# TK-012 гейт: NEW=alpha-a5d4e3a против alpha-e74f200-v3 на 03.08 (e-aug). (1) lob touches D20 + --minute-flow:
# touches-*.csv побайтно, approaches-*.csv первые 22 колонки побайтно; (2) 23 клетки --cells без флагов = runs/e08-grp;
# (3) группы st/ex/ea/main = g08/grp-2026-08-03-*; (4) --p08-cols на новом кэше: rounds/forms = без флага, signals 1–11 кол. те же.
NEW=${NEW:-alpha-a5d4e3a}; A=$HOME/alpha; H=$A/epochs/e-aug; O=$A/tmp-t38/g12; L=$O/gate.log; D=2026-08-03
rm -rf $O; mkdir -p $O/app/D20/$D $O/mf; cd "$H" || exit 1
say() { echo "== $(date -u +%FT%TZ) $*" >> "$L"; }
body() { grep -av '^#' "$1"; }
bad=0; n=0
chk() { n=$((n+1)); if ! cmp -s "$1" "$2"; then bad=$((bad+1)); say "  ≠ $3"; fi; }
say "старт NEW=$NEW"
# (1) кэш подходов
t0=$(date +%s)
xargs -a study/touches/$D/symbols.txt -P 3 -I{} sh -c "nice -n 5 $A/bin/$NEW lob touches --root study/root-$D --symbol {} --h3-mode notional --h3-usd 10000 --approach-bps 20 --minute-flow $O/mf --out $O/app/D20/$D/touches-{}.csv > $O/app/D20/$D/{}.log 2>&1"
say "(1) lob touches $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) с; монет $(wc -l < study/touches/$D/symbols.txt), minute-flow файлов $(ls $O/mf | wc -l)"
OC=study/approaches/D20/$D
for f in $OC/touches-*.csv; do b=$(basename $f); chk <(body $f) <(body $O/app/D20/$D/$b) "touches $b"; done
for f in $OC/approaches-*.csv; do b=$(basename $f); chk <(body $f) <(body $O/app/D20/$D/$b | cut -d, -f1-22) "approaches $b"; done
say "(1) новых колонок: $(head -1 $O/app/D20/$D/approaches-AAVEUSDT.csv | tr ',' '\n' | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
# (2) 23 клетки
bash $A/tmp-t38/cellrun.sh tk12-nof $NEW $D --hold-step skip --exit-group on
R=$A/tmp-t38/runs
for f in $R/e08-grp/*/*.csv $R/e08-grp/*.csv; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; rel=${f#$R/e08-grp/}; chk <(body $f) <(body $R/tk12-nof/$rel) "cells $rel"; done
say "(2) время $(head -1 $R/tk12-nof.time); e74f200-v3 было $(head -1 $R/e08-grp.time)"
# (3) группы
RTT="--median-rtt-ns place=4200000,cancel=3980000,taker=5650000 --p95-rtt-ns place=4790000,cancel=4550000,taker=6420000"
C="--signal approach --queue-model prob:3 $RTT --regime-from study/regime --order-usd 500 --carry-root root --h3-mode notional --h3-usd 10000 --entry-ttl-secs 1800 --band-exit-bps 20 --threads 1 --entry-form single@fr"
SETS="--set t-bid-btc4h-q1:age=2700,side=bid,btc4h_max=-44.55 --set h3-25000:age=2700,side=bid,btc4h_max=-44.55,usd_min=25000 --set h4-900:age=900,side=bid,btc4h_max=-44.55"
declare -A AX
AX[st]="--busy-skip off --exit-form none --stop-form pct2 --stop-form pct1.5 --stop-form before --take-form tr1x1 --take-form 1to1 --take-form eat50x80 --take-form half1to1 --take-form tk1 --deadline-secs 14400 --deadline-secs 3600 $SETS"
AX[ex]="--busy-skip off --stop-form pct2 --take-form tr1x1 --deadline-secs 14400 --deadline-secs 7200 --exit-form none --exit-form eat20 --exit-form gone50 --exit-form gone90tr0.5 --exit-form gone50be --exit-form gone90bex --exit-form gone90wall0 --exit-form gone90wallx0 --exit-form gone90wallk0 $SETS"
AX[ea]="--busy-skip off --exit-form none --stop-form pct2 --stop-form before --take-form tr1x1 --take-form 1to1 --deadline-secs 14400 --early-exit-secs off --early-exit-secs 1 --early-exit-secs 3 $SETS"
AX[main]="--busy-skip on --exit-form none --stop-form pct2 --take-form tr1x1 --deadline-secs 14400 --set main:age=2700,side=bid,btc4h_max=-44.55"
G=$A/tmp-t38/g08
for k in st ex ea main; do nice -n 5 $A/bin/$NEW lob bounce-grid --root study/root-$D --touches-from study/approaches/D20 $C ${AX[$k]} --hold-step skip --exit-group on --out-dir $O/grp-$k > $O/grp-$k.log 2>&1 & done
# (4) --p08-cols на новом кэше: с флагом и без
for p in on off; do F=""; [ $p = on ] && F="--p08-cols"
  nice -n 5 $A/bin/$NEW lob bounce-grid --root study/root-$D --touches-from $O/app/D20 $C ${AX[st]} --hold-step skip --exit-group on $F --out-dir $O/p08-$p > $O/p08-$p.log 2>&1 & done
wait
for k in st ex ea main; do for f in $G/grp-$D-$k/*/*.csv; do rel=${f#$G/grp-$D-$k/}; chk <(body $f) <(body $O/grp-$k/$rel) "grp-$k $rel"; done; done
for f in $O/p08-off/*/*.csv; do rel=${f#$O/p08-off/}; case $rel in *signals*) chk <(body $f) <(body $O/p08-on/$rel | cut -d, -f1-11) "p08 $rel (1–11)";; *) chk <(body $f) <(body $O/p08-on/$rel) "p08 $rel";; esac; done
# p08-off на новом кэше = старый кэш (st)
for f in $G/grp-$D-st/*/*.csv; do rel=${f#$G/grp-$D-st/}; chk <(body $f) <(body $O/p08-off/$rel) "новый кэш st $rel"; done
S1=$(ls $O/p08-on/*/signals*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1); say "(4) signals с флагом: $(head -c 400 <(body $S1 | head -2))"
say "rc логов: $(grep -il 'error\|panic' $O/*.log | tr '\n' ' ')"
say "сверено файлов $n (тела без шапки), расхождений $bad"
say "ИТОГ: $([ $bad = 0 ] && [ $n -gt 0 ] && echo зелёный || echo красный)"
EOF
K=(-i /c/Users/Георгий/.ssh/id_rsa -o UserKnownHostsFile=/c/Users/Георгий/.ssh/known_hosts -o ConnectTimeout=15)
scp -q "${K[@]}" "$S/gate12.sh" deck@192.168.1.49:alpha/tmp-t38/gate12.sh && ssh "${K[@]}" deck@192.168.1.49 'cd ~/alpha && bash -n tmp-t38/gate12.sh && ls tmp-t38/runs/e08-grp | head -5; ls tmp-t38/g08/grp-2026-08-03-st | head -3; ls tmp-t38/g08/grp-2026-08-03-st/* | head -5'
tool_input.description: Write gate script and ship to deck

result: Бинарник alpha-a5d4e3a собран на VPS и уже на Steam Deck, проверка на 03.08 идёт в фоне.
